title.narrative: Building Integrity and National Accountability in Lebanon (BINA)

description.narrative: BINA aims to improve governance and promote reform in Lebanon. The project will enhance the role of civil society actors actively contributing to governance, accountability and transparency in Lebanon. This includes organisational abilities and more coordinated efforts among civil society networks to ensure transparent and sustainable implementation of the international reconstruction framework called “3RF”. Value of the contract is EUR 2,800,000.
